scope.oc_path_policy: Plain OC uses natural user text, plain dialogue and no offered tools or response-format schema. Channel/source fields are backend scene bindings, not model choices. scope.format_repair_policy: Tool-task path only: optional paired sidecar, preserving baseline output/checks/history.
